title: Product sync — scope lock

summary_markdown:
## Key decisions

- Q4 scope is locked at four items: sleep mode, the calibration patch, BLE diagnostic mode, and cloud retry.
- Cloud retry stays on the list but has no owner; it is parked until the other three show how much room is left.
- The Solenne drift root cause is confirmed as the stale thermistor reference curve on rev B, not the sensor.
- A firmware freeze on September 25 was proposed and both Maya and Tomas agreed to it.

## Discussion

Maya confirmed the drift diagnosis: swapping the sensor on the bench unit left the drift in place, while swapping in a corrected reference table removed it. The table baked into rev B was fitted to an older thermistor batch. She will build a corrected lookup table from her chamber data and ship it as a patch, with no hardware change, expecting Solenne's error to fall from about four points to under one. Tomas will take the firmware side of BLE diagnostic mode once sleep mode is validated, while the owner chases the companion-app timeline with the mobile team. Nobody had capacity for cloud retry, so it was parked. Inès reported rev C is still in fab, with boards about a week away, and Tomas will characterise them for current draw when they land.

## Action items

Three items: the owner chases the BLE companion-app timeline with mobile before the freeze, Tomas characterises rev C boards when they land, and Maya builds the corrected lookup table.

## Open questions

- Whether cloud retry makes Q4 at all, and who would own it.
- Whether the BLE companion app can be ready before the freeze.

- Need mobile's timeline for the BLE app before freeze
